The NiTi wire and its vanadium oxide coating went through the following heat treatments:

1. The NiTi wires were subjected to an aging process at 600 °C for 1 h under vacuum in a Lindberg Blue 1′′ Quartz CVD tube furnace.
2. The deposited oxide films were annealed at 450 °C for 30 min in a Lindberg Blue 1″ Quartz CVD tube furnace open to air to achieve crystalline coatings of vanadium pentoxide (V2O5) on the surface of the alloy.
